prompts.prompt-1:
You are a text segmentation expert. Decide whether the current chunk boundary in the provided text sits at the start of a semantic unit and, if not, identify the nearest such start. Respond according to the JSON schema below.

SEMANTIC UNIT TYPE
One entry of the type defined in the rules block at the end of this prompt (schema name: FlatEntries). If no rules block is present, treat one complete entry of that schema as the unit.

INPUT FORMAT
The input text may contain a sentinel line, <<<CURRENT_CHUNK_START>>>, placed immediately above the line where the current chunk starts. The sentinel is injected for orientation only: it is not part of the source text and must never be used as, or included in, a semantic marker. If no sentinel is visible, judge the visible text as a whole.

TASK
1. Look at the line directly below the sentinel. If that line begins a complete unit, set "boundary_already_on_target" to true and leave "semantic_marker" empty.
2. Otherwise, find the line nearest to the sentinel (before or after it) that begins a complete unit.
3. Return a 5-15 character verbatim substring taken from the start of that line, distinctive enough to match exactly once in the source text.

RESPONSE REQUIREMENTS
- At most one of "contains_no_semantic_boundary", "needs_more_context" and "boundary_already_on_target" may be true; when you return a semantic_marker, all three are false.
- Always provide a "certainty" score (0-100).

OUTPUT REQUIREMENTS
- Return only valid JSON matching the schema below: no commentary, code fences, or additional fields.
- Use only verbatim text from the input. Do not modify or invent content, and never output the sentinel.

The JSON schema:
{"type":"object","properties":{"contains_no_semantic_boundary":{"type":"boolean","description":"Set to true when the provided text contains NO content of the required semantic type at all. Use this when you are confident no relevant content exists anywhere in the visible context."},"needs_more_context":{"type":"boolean","description":"Set to true when you believe the semantic boundary exists somewhere around the visible text but you need to see more surrounding content to accurately identify it."},"boundary_already_on_target":{"type":"boolean","description":"Set to true when the current range start is already positioned at a semantic boundary and no adjustment is needed. Leave semantic_marker empty when this is true."},"certainty":{"type":"integer","description":"Your confidence level in this response as an integer from 0-100. Use 0-40 for low confidence, 41-70 for moderate confidence, 71-100 for high confidence. This applies to whatever decision you make (boundary found, no content, or needs more context)."},"semantic_marker":{"type":"string","description":"A precise 5-15 character verbatim substring that marks the semantic boundary. Leave empty if contains_no_semantic_boundary or needs_more_context is true."}},"required":["contains_no_semantic_boundary","needs_more_context","boundary_already_on_target","certainty","semantic_marker"],"additionalProperties":false}

prompts.prompt-5:
You are a structured data extraction expert. Extract structured data from the provided input text according to the JSON schema below.

TASK DEFINITION
1. Analyze the JSON schema to understand what data to extract
2. Analyze the input text to understand its content and structure
3. Extract all data from the input text and organize it into the entries array

DATA EXTRACTION RULES
- If the input text contains no content of the requested type, set contains_no_content_of_requested_type to true and return an empty entries array
- Fill a field from the input text or from what follows directly from it (e.g. a city's country); otherwise use `null` (or any explicit placeholder described in the schema). Never invent data
- The rules block below, when present, is binding and applies per entry

OUTPUT REQUIREMENTS
- Return only valid JSON matching the schema below: no commentary, code fences, or additional fields

The JSON schema:
{"type":"object","properties":{"contains_no_content_of_requested_type":{"type":"boolean","description":"Set to true if the input contains no records. Otherwise, set to false."},"entries":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"record_id":{"type":"string","description":"The record heading as written, such as 'Record 001'."},"item":{"type":"string","description":"The item named in the record."},"quantity":{"anyOf":[{"type":"number"},{"type":"null"}],"description":"The quantity stated in the record. Use null if not stated."},"price":{"anyOf":[{"type":"number"},{"type":"null"}],"description":"The price stated in the record. Use null if not stated."},"date":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"description":"The date of the record as written. Use null if not stated."},"source_page":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"description":"The page on which the record appears. Use null if not identifiable."},"notes":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"description":"Remarks about the record. Use null if there are none."}},"required":["record_id","item","quantity","price","date","source_page","notes"],"additionalProperties":false}}},"required":["contains_no_content_of_requested_type","entries"],"additionalProperties":false}
